text:
ok great so then before we go at it, tell me the outcome of these which should be true after the changes land, and make sure we are on the same page


start app -> new mesh -> several edits -> code update -> ??
does it 
A: retain the mesh edits over the update
b: dump the updates
c: neither

start app -> new mesh -> some edits -> exit
does it
A: retain the edits for next start up
b: dump the edits
c: neither

start app -> new mesh -> save -> edit -> exit 
does it
A: retain a most relevant autosave file that has all updates
b: dump updates, original file preserved 
c: neither
resolution: Locked the expected lifecycle matrix before implementation: an unsaved mesh survives an in-process code update through hot handoff without becoming a disk package; an unsaved mesh is discarded across a full app exit/restart; after explicit first Save establishes a valid model package, subsequent edits autosave into that package and a normal exit flushes pending writes so the latest edits survive restart. Distinguished graceful exit from an unflushable hard process kill. No files changed.
